name: Classic Dark Sidebar
description: A classic two-column layout featuring a dark grey left sidebar for personal info, skills, and languages with progress bars, and a clean right column for detailed experience and education.
customCss: .sidebar { background-color: #374151; color: #ffffff; } .sidebar h2 { background-color: #1F2937; padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 4px; margin-top: 15px; margin-bottom: 10px; } .sidebar p { margin-bottom: 5px; font-size: 13px; } .progress-bar-container { background-color: #4B5563; height: 6px; border-radius: 3px; margin-top: 5px; } .progress-bar { background-color: #ffffff; height: 6px; border-radius: 3px; } .right-content h2 { border-bottom: 2px solid #D1D5DB; padding-bottom: 5px; margin-bottom: 10px; font-weight: bold; }
